email_body:

I write and present in fluent English, work comfortably with stakeholders across markets, and can travel 60%. I'd be glad to discuss how I can support your clinical education and enablement programmes.

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Marketing Associate, Clinical Education position in Stryker's Peripheral Vascular division. I'll be direct about my starting point: my experience is in digital marketing, not medical devices. What I bring is the ability to take complex material, understand it properly, and turn it into content people actually use — plus the organisational habits to make education programmes run on time.

Content development is the core of my current role at Episto. I handle keyword research, SEO writing and on-page optimisation for client websites, and I manage publishing in WordPress from start to finish. One project I'm proud of is majistraleczacilari.org.tr, a pharmacists' association site I built and maintain, including a consistent layout for around 600 member profiles. Working for a professional healthcare audience taught me that accuracy and clarity aren't nice-to-haves; when someone relies on your page, sloppy detail costs trust.

Before that, I worked as a front-end developer on a healthcare web application at ViviDoctor, so clinical terminology and regulated environments aren't unfamiliar to me. I also spent two years at Knowledge Experts supporting SharePoint-based digital workplaces for large organisations — projects with many stakeholders, fixed deadlines and interdependencies, which is where I learned to track details without losing sight of the outcome.

I use Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs daily to measure what content does, so evaluating whether an education programme landed and reporting on it clearly would be natural ground for me. I'm fluent in English, comfortable working across markets and cultures, and happy to travel 60%.

I'm eager to learn the Peripheral Vascular portfolio and the disease states behind it. Stryker's mission of making healthcare better is the kind of thing I'd like my work attached to.

Thank you for your time.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
